## Reference-repair policy (proposed)

Precedent (how v0/v1 were archived): live load-bearing files (CHANGELOG, README, AGENTS) were repaired to `docs/archive/...` paths; example/fixture/log stragglers were tolerated. This run follows the same policy:

**Repair (live, load-bearing):** `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`, `README_zh.md`, `AGENTS.md`, active `docs/v3.x/*`, `docs/policy/`, `docs/specs/`, and live skill/hook bodies that link into v2 (`catalog/skills/{tasks-to-issues,continuous-learning,skill-eval-loop,spec-driven-development}`, `catalog/hooks/session-summary.{sh,ps1}` if behavioral).

**Leave as historical (deliberate):** `docs/DEVLOG.md` (83 refs -- append-only history), `data/skills.json` `based_on` provenance citations (31 -- regenerated from source; cite original provenance), internal v2-to-v2 references now frozen inside `docs/archive/v2/`, the `docs-layout-refactor` skill's own example paths, `catalog/agents/*-reviewer.md` example paths, and test fixtures (`tests/`, `catalog/hooks/tests/`) that use version-doc paths as test data.

**Verify after:** `make validate`, `make test`, and a refgraph re-scan; if a test or validator breaks on a moved path, address it specifically rather than blanket-rewriting.

## Layout Inconsistencies

The project uses the **legacy flat layout** (`docs/<vSEMVER>/`) and the **legacy archive layout** (`docs/archive/v<MAJOR>/v<SEMVER>/`). This run deliberately KEEPS the legacy archive convention so v2 lands at `docs/archive/v2/v2.X.0/` consistent with the existing `docs/archive/v0/`, `docs/archive/v1/`. Canonicalization to `docs/versions/` + `docs/archive/versions/` is NOT performed (it would be a separate, repo-wide `--canonicalize-layout` migration affecting v3.x too).

## Self-classification

This report is Cat 4 (transient/active) and lives in the in-flight `docs/v3/v3.1/`. A future `/refactor-docs` run will promote it to Cat 2 once v3.1.0 is no longer active.
